title: 1729 SWMM5 Models 2030: A Library of EPA SWMM5 Test and Reference Models
description:
A curated library of EPA SWMM5 input (.inp) models covering hydrology, hydraulics, LID controls, force mains, pumps, weirs, orifices and dynamic-wave routing, together with XPSWMM conversions and training examples. Each model carries an auto-generated Markdown summary.

Assembled and maintained by Robert E. Dickinson. The models are released into the public domain under The Unlicense, matching EPA SWMM5's own public-domain status.
